brief: Clear any encroaching vegetation or obstructions to maintain unobstructed airflow to the radiator banks and ventilation openings, giving clearance work precedence over other remedial activity as specified in SOP-011 and SOP-015. Reduce the permissible load using the ambient de-rating method in MG-021, which requires a 1.5 percent reduction of rating for each degree of average ambient above 30 degrees over the preceding 24 hours. Additionally, apply any required reductions for reduced cooling or sustained multi-day events according to MG-021, and record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period.
